title: 2017 Toyota Camry Hood Repaint and Grille Replacement
summary: A black 2017 Toyota Camry with a repainted hood and a new front grille, colour matched and finished in Vancouver, WA.
story: A black 2017 Toyota Camry came in for a repainted hood and a new front grille, with the old grille damaged and the hood due for refinishing.

Carlos stripped the hood back, sanded and prepped the panel, then laid down primer, base and clear. Black is one of the least forgiving colours to match, so the hood was blended against the fenders rather than sprayed in isolation.
The new grille assembly went on once the paint had cured, and the finished front end was checked in daylight for coverage and colour before the car went back to its owner.
